metadata.title: Besicovitch Covering on Alexandrov Spaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that finite-dimensional geodesic locally compact Alexandrov spaces with curvature bounded below (CBB), and in particular complete Riemannian manifolds with lower bounded sectional curvature, satisfy a Besicovitch covering theorem by showing that they are directionally limited in the sense of Federer.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 下曲率 Alexandrov 空间的 Besicovitch 覆盖
analysis.workSummary: 证明有限维、测地、局部紧的 CBB Alexandrov 空间具有 Federer 意义的 directional limitation，从而满足 Besicovitch 覆盖定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典覆盖工具推广到奇异下曲率空间。
analysis.limitations: 有限维、测地及局部紧条件须同时保留。
